description: Model-agnostic Go2 route capture definitions. Commands and complete reference/executed trajectories are retained; no training window or waypoint count is fixed.

route_anchor_policy.disclosure: The seven scenes use visually validated metre-like numeric coordinates even though their source metadata says metersPerUnit=0.01. Every derived anchor, source metadata value and actual pose is retained; no SI-scale claim is inferred from metadata alone.

navigation_defaults.disclosure: Waypoints are a high-level route in the initial Go2 body XY frame. The frozen locomotion policy executes velocity commands; no gait training or low-level joint planning is performed.

global_route_planner.disclosure: Global reference route: 2.5D traversability grid from PhysX down-rays, ESDF, A* (biased to corridor centre), ESDF-gradient local adjustment, curvature-limited cubic spline, then a dense 0.12 m full-corridor PhysX sweep before admission. The endpoint is sampled from the robot's spawn heading so the first leg stays inside max_first_leg_heading_deviation_rad (the frozen gait avoids large in-place turns); the deviation is relaxed in steps and the used value is recorded. All parameters are authored in metres and converted explicitly through the USD stage metersPerUnit.

navigation.disclosure: Portable external roadside route; start XY/yaw and runtime support are provided by configs/dynamic_agents/routes/scene08_go2_roadside_route.json.

rough_height_scan_proxy.source: Repeated scene_09 PhysX ground-cluster probes at the admitted road spawn.
rough_height_scan_proxy.limitation: Invisible non-colliding flat height observation for the frozen rough locomotion policy only; RGB, depth, contacts and route admission still use the source scene.

navigation.disclosure: Select an eight-unit continuous lane/white-line support corridor, move forward one way and stop. The route avoids reverse walking and slow in-place turnaround. The old 120-second open-loop run plateaued after about 20 seconds and is diagnostic, not a valid long-route result.

road_corridor_probe.disclosure: Candidate headings are tested before motion with PhysX ground and obstacle rays. Only a continuous lane-height, obstacle-free out-and-back corridor is admitted.

navigation.disclosure: The smoke route heading is selected from deterministic candidates by a pre-motion PhysX road-corridor probe, then the Go2 stops at the final waypoint instead of making a risky in-place 180-degree turn. This keeps the preview on a low-difficulty lane and away from vehicles, lamps and curbs; longer formal routes still require separate wide-turn planning.

Probe an eight-unit corridor on the actual flat support collider before any motion. The source collider is named NonWalkable_000, so a geometrically admitted route still exposes a semantic-label mismatch and is not called a semantically valid road.

global_route_planner.disclosure: Planning is confined to an L-shaped polygon: the 2.25 m market corridor column at x ~ -30 (y 36 to 46) plus a 1.5 m tall walkable market band (y 37 to 40) that runs east from the corridor mouth to x 8. The robot spawns at (-28.5, 44.5) just north of the corridor mouth and faces south (start_yaw_override_rad -1.5708). With target_route_length_m [16, 19] and min_total_turn_rad 1.047 the admitted route turns ~104 deg from the south-facing entry (heading -104 deg) to face due east (heading 0 deg), then drives ~10 m straight along the market band to goal (-16.1, 39.9) -- a genuine single-turn route whose net heading change (104 deg) equals its cumulative turn, unlike earlier routes whose turn was only entry wobble. The allowed-region polygon is restricted so A* cannot take the wide open road to the east; endpoint sampling is uniform over all in-band cells (endpoint_sample_attempts 2000, sample_seed 20260812) so the geodesic-length filter admits this bending band route. Ground support is Walkable_001; market stalls, cars and NonWalkable_005 are rejected by down-rays. The command layer is tracking_controller=pure_pursuit (PurePursuitController resamples the polyline to 0.05 m, chases a 1.2 m lookahead, emits vx/yaw_rate with a 0.28 m/s forward floor so the command stays inside the gait envelope during the corridor-entry turn).

road_corridor_probe.disclosure: Legacy fixed-direction probe retained for provenance only; it is not executed because the scene mode is global_planned.

navigation.disclosure: The global reference-route planner builds a traversability grid from PhysX down-rays over the north road band, computes an ESDF, samples start/end in one connected component, runs A*, locally adjusts and spline-smooths the path, then sweeps the full robot-width corridor with dense PhysX rays before any motion. The source labels drivable ground Walkable_* and surrounding ground NonWalkable_*; only geometrically admitted walkable support is used and a route is never called a semantically valid road without probing.
